Native multivariate MIAAFT Lyapunov surrogate hypothesis test

etr_multivariate_surrogate_nonlinearity_test.Rd

Tests the declared largest-Lyapunov statistic under reference-anchored multivariate IAAFT surrogates. Rejecting the null does not establish deterministic chaos or a unique nonlinear mechanism. Uses sample units and preserves native Fourier phases by default. Numerically unresolved phases may be replayed from a comparison backend.

Usage

etr_multivariate_surrogate_nonlinearity_test(trajectories, curve,
  dimensions, reference_dimension, statistic,
  embedding_dimension, delay, theiler_window, max_horizon,
  fit_start, fit_end, delay_units = "samples",
  theiler_window_units = "samples", max_horizon_units = "samples",
  fit_units = "samples", n_surrogates = 199L,
  alternative = "greater", max_iterations = 1000L,
  tolerance = 1e-8, random_state = NULL,
  initial_permutations = NULL, phase_replay = NULL,
  python_boundary_mode = FALSE)

Arguments

trajectories

Native complete regular common-grid trajectory set.

curve

Source curve ID or zero-based index.

dimensions

At least two explicitly selected channel names.

reference_dimension

Explicit selected reference channel.

statistic

Only largest_lyapunov.

embedding_dimension

Embedding dimension.

delay,theiler_window,max_horizon,fit_start,fit_end

Integer sample units.

delay_units,theiler_window_units,max_horizon_units,fit_units

Must equal samples.

n_surrogates

Positive number of generated null surrogates.

alternative

greater, less or two-sided.

max_iterations,tolerance

MIAAFT convergence controls.

random_state

Integer seed for NumPy-compatible PCG64 initialization or NULL for unseeded native R draws.

initial_permutations

Optional zero-based (n_surrogates, n_time, n_selected_dimensions) complete per-channel initialization permutations, forwarded to the MIAAFT generator.

phase_replay

Optional Fourier phases for unresolved bins, forwarded to etr_generate_multivariate_iaaft_surrogates.

python_boundary_mode

If TRUE, use the declared source boundary semantics; FALSE preserves native validation defaults.

Value

Native multivariate Lyapunov statistic, surrogate distribution, source-defined plus-one tail p-value and complete surrogate diagnostics.
